sentences.en: Could you dial for me? The telephone is too high.
sentences.zh: 你能帮我拨号吗？电话太高了。

sentences.en: I couldn't call you; the telephone was out of order.
sentences.zh: 我打不了电话；电话出了故障。

sentences.en: Helen telephoned me that she had arrived in London safely.
sentences.zh: 海伦打电话告诉我她安全抵达伦敦。

senses.zh: 以电话传送(消息), 给(某人)打电话
